effectiveRequest.style: English, melodic indie pop, clear lead vocal, piano, electric guitar, bass and drums, 100 BPM, uplifting chorus
effectiveRequest.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The rain has left a silver line
Across the road we used to know
I pack a little piece of time
And follow where the rivers go

[Pre-Chorus]
Every window catches light
Every step becomes a sound
We can make it through the night
With our feet upon the ground

[Chorus]
Carry the morning home with me
Over the hills and through the trees
There is a song in all we see
Carry the morning home with me

[Verse 2]
The station clock is running slow
A paper cup warms up my hands
There is so much I do not know
About the shape of distant lands

[Chorus]
Carry the morning home with me
Over the hills and through the trees
There is a song in all we see
Carry the morning home with me

[Bridge]
If the road should turn again
If the clouds should hide the blue
We will sing above the rain
I will find my way with you

[Chorus]
Carry the morning home with me
Over the hills and through the trees
There is a song in all we see
Carry the morning home with me

[Outro]
One more mile and we are free
Carry the morning home with me
[End]

memoryScope: yue-synth process RSS sampled every 100 ms; GPU is device-wide nvidia-smi memory.used sampled every 250 ms minus the pre-run baseline, including any other GPU clients
findings: Five consecutive full-song processes: no upward trend in time, process RSS, or GPU use; the idle GPU baseline was the same before each job
Every run produced the identical WAV, matching the earlier full run
limitations: Each job is a new yue-synth process, as the CLI works; a long-lived worker that keeps models loaded between jobs is not tested
Five jobs are a short soak, not a long-duration leak test
